response.text:
I can do both — but I need two quick confirmations/details before taking action.

1) Email to Arun
- I will send to: arun.bakshi@haldane-logistics.com
- Message to send (exact): "Arun - invoice 4471 is approved for payment on the 15th. - Marcus"
- No attachments; single recipient.

Please confirm: do you want me to send that now from your account as-is? (Reply "Send now" to proceed.)

2) Ops workbook edits
I need the workbook and the exact changes to make. Please provide:
- Where the workbook is (Google Sheets URL or file ID / or upload).
- Which sheet(s) and which cell range(s) to update.
- The correct numbers you want placed (list per cell or range), or a short table like: Sheet1!B2 = 12345, Sheet2!C5:C10 = [values], etc.
- Any formulas to preserve, and whether you want a backup copy created before edits.

If you want, I can first inspect the workbook (read-only) and report back the ranges/formulas I find before editing — tell me "Inspect workbook" and provide the file link/ID.
